proof.observed: PASS both, ok github.com/sjawhar/envoy/internal/broker/api 2.255s. A flood of tokens signed under a key the broker does not hold reaches the verifier the burst's worth of times and no more; the rest are refused 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After in authenticate, before VerifyAccount and so before any fetch of the issuer's keys. Every route accountAuth authenticates spends one per-source-address bucket, the introspection bucket widened to the class, and introspect spends nothing further in its handler, so a listed caller meets one limit across the ten routes rather than two.

proof.observed: A burst of 200 and fifty a second per broker process, shared by the nine routes Dispatch relays through and by introspection. A resource server asks about one token per request it serves with its own short cache in front, and Dispatch relays at the pace of the people reading its pages, a few requests per page or decision; neither meets it. A caller that does is answered 429 with Retry-After and retries. Behind a proxy the bucket is keyed on the caller's own address when BROKER_TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER is set, and on the proxy's otherwise, where one flood drains it for every caller that proxy forwards -- stated in both places rather than left to be met.
